schema_note: Minimal example conforming to feature-list.schema.json. This shows the scale-down case: a 1-entry feature-list, valid ONLY when all four conditions from plan.template.md §Feature list hold: (a) exactly one observable behavior added/changed/removed, (b) exactly one verification command (no hidden pipeline sub-checks), (c) zero cross-phase dependencies, (d) touched-files ≤ 3. Any deviation requires multiple entries. Paths are repo-root-relative per D-11.
